d = \frac{|ax_1 + by_1 + cz_1 + d|}{\sqrt{a^2 + b^2 + c^2}}

formulas.tex: \cos\theta = \dfrac{\vec a\cdot\vec b}{|\vec a||\vec b|},\quad 0\le\theta\le\pi
\text{scalar} = \dfrac{\vec a\cdot\vec b}{|\vec b|},\qquad \text{vector} = \left(\dfrac{\vec a\cdot\vec b}{|\vec b|^2}\right)\vec b

note.en: unit vectors: $|\hat a + \hat b| = 2\cos\tfrac{\theta}{2},\ |\hat a - \hat b| = 2\sin\tfrac{\theta}{2}$

formulas.tex: \vec a\times\vec b = \begin{vmatrix}\hat i & \hat j & \hat k\\ a_1 & a_2 & a_3\\ b_1 & b_2 & b_3\end{vmatrix},\quad |\vec a\times\vec b| = |\vec a||\vec b|\sin\theta

note.en: $\hat i\times\hat j = \hat k,\ \hat j\times\hat k = \hat i,\ \hat k\times\hat i = \hat j$; $\vec b\times\vec a = -\vec a\times\vec b$

name.en: Unit vector perpendicular to a and b

|\vec a\times\vec b|^2 + (\vec a\cdot\vec b)^2 = |\vec a|^2|\vec b|^2

note.en: cyclic shifts keep the value; swapping two vectors changes the sign; a repeated vector gives 0. Triple products: JEE Advanced (not in JEE Main 2024 or rationalised NCERT)

formulas.tex: V_{\text{parallelepiped}} = |[\vec a\ \vec b\ \vec c]|,\quad V_{\text{tetrahedron}} = \tfrac16|[\vec a\ \vec b\ \vec c]|,\quad \text{coplanar} \iff [\vec a\ \vec b\ \vec c] = 0
[\vec a + \vec b\ \ \vec b + \vec c\ \ \vec c + \vec a] = 2[\vec a\ \vec b\ \vec c],\qquad [\vec a\times\vec b\ \ \vec b\times\vec c\ \ \vec c\times\vec a] = [\vec a\ \vec b\ \vec c]^2
\vec a\times(\vec b\times\vec c) = (\vec a\cdot\vec c)\vec b - (\vec a\cdot\vec b)\vec c

note.en: not associative: $(\vec a\times\vec b)\times\vec c = (\vec a\cdot\vec c)\vec b - (\vec b\cdot\vec c)\vec a$

formulas.tex: \vec a\times\vec b = \vec a\times\vec c \Rightarrow \vec b - \vec c = \lambda\vec a\ \ (\text{not } \vec b = \vec c)
